reason: Verify every database, API, worker, borrowed-browser, deduplication, error, privacy, UI, and required-test contract against the final implementation.
Audit migration safety, short transactions, foreign keys, deterministic queries, active-row reconciliation, rollback, and temporary-file tests.
Force malformed, missing, conflict, storage, worker, timeout, and internal paths and verify exact sanitized status/code/message behavior.
Confirm only enabled immutable rule snapshots feed search and monitoring-rule CRUD remains platform-free and compatible.
Regression-check all five account probes, unchanged auth v2 frames, global serialization, cancellation, shutdown, and borrowed Chrome cleanup.
Audit visible DOM classification, URL allowlisting, bounded fields, masking, fail-closed behavior, and the explicit fresh-versus-borrowed lifecycle separation.
Verify Shadcn integrity, API runtime decoding, TanStack Query/form ownership, route semantics, accessibility, responsive behavior, and full frontend gates.
Check derivative cleanliness/reachability, commit order, parent gitlink reproducibility, and absence of untracked runtime data before delivery.
Trace every status, identifier, term match, count, timestamp, filter, and error end to end and reject duplicate or locally reinterpreted contracts.
Check for duplicate worker ownership, operation locks, status maps, platform catalogs, API decoders, query hooks, and UI primitives.
Verify the implementation closes each audited Toutiao/worker/product gap and does not accidentally expose the four deferred platform searches.
Confirm real acceptance reuses only the approved local Chrome path and preserves all user-owned browser state.
Confirm FastAPI retains subprocess isolation and never imports MediaCrawler runtime/config globals.
Compare the borrowed-context live result and hard-limit behavior with the recorded standalone baseline without treating it as borrowed-context proof.
